moments.text: Title card: "UAP 2021, Apparent Instantaneous Acceleration Examination, original clip excerpt at 100% speed"; part of the title is blacked out.
Infrared view: a bright glowing spot sits in a box at the crosshair; from 19 s it drifts up and left, shrinking to a dot.
The dot stretches into a short horizontal streak and crosses to the right edge in about 5 frames (~0.17 s); use frame step.
Card: "white edge threshold enhancement in attempt to highlight UAP shape". The replay shows a ragged white spot; it streaks off right at 47.5 s.
Card: "50% speed". Half-speed replay: the spot drifts up-left from the crosshair, then streaks off to the right at 1:02.5.
Card: "25% speed". Quarter-speed replay of the same drift; the streak crosses to the right edge at 1:15.5.
Card: "5% speed". The dot creeps up-left, then its streak slides slowly across the top to the right from 1:29.5.
Card: "B/W values inverted, picture zoomed". The spot shows as a dark blob in a box at the crosshair; it streaks off right at 1:58.3.
Card: "full original clip TRT: 2:52". A wide, noisy view slews over fields and roads, with bright exposure flashes.
Zoomed in over terrain: a small bright dot near the crosshair, boxed with a 42M readout at 3:01, then wandering around the crosshair.
A box reticle locks with a 31M readout; a small bracket closes on the dot below-left as the readout counts down to 6M.
The opening is replayed: the glowing spot drifts up-left and streaks off right at 4:45.3, then the view sweeps over terrain to the end.

notes: Uploader-edited compilation (title cards, enhanced and slowed replays). Official timestamps run about 1 s early, and the official list omits the '5% speed' segment (1:20-1:36 here).
